input: # Everything here is outside the specification's grammar, and every
# rejection is the engine's base `unexpected` code — this plugin declares
# no codes of its own (see AGENTS.md). Every verdict here was checked
# against the regular expression semver.org publishes, the same judge
# ts/test/oracle.test.ts and go/oracle_test.go use; those suites grade a
# generated corpus rather than this file, so they do not re-check these
# rows. Both runtimes run every row through the shared parity runners.
# Leading zeros in the version core.
# Whitespace anywhere. The engine's default lexers are off, so a blank
# is an unexpected character like any other, not skipped.
# Comments, quotes and punctuation the engine would otherwise lex.
# Empty pre-release / build, and empty identifiers inside them.
# Leading zeros in NUMERIC pre-release identifiers.
# A second pre-release or build separator.
# Non-ASCII, including letters and digits other scripts would accept.
